description: Hunting, dungeons, dying and levelling from Living Server, rewritten.

lines.text: Is it normal to run out of power this fast? Asking for a friend.
Anyone else get lost on the way to {zone}? The roads all look the same.
Got my first real weapon drop, feeling dangerous now.
What does grey con even mean, do I still get experience?
Learning the hard way that blue con is not always easy.
Is {zone} safe for a {level}?
How long did 20 take everyone? Feels like forever.
Is it worth doing the town quests or just grind?
Just died to a {target} I was sure I could take.
Should I sell my old armor or keep it for later?
Went wandering past {zone} and found a whole camp nobody uses.
There is a waterfall past the hills, worth the walk just to see it.
Saw something huge walking the road near {zone}, ran the other way.
Anyone ever been all the way to the edge of the map? What is out there.
Pulled a yellow and an orange at once, somehow lived.
Who says you cannot solo oranges at {level}.
How is {zone} for a {level} {class}?
Spent half an hour looking for a group, gave up and soloed.
All right, who left a train on the road to {zone}.
How do people level a {class} past 30 without losing their mind?
Finally made it to {zone}, the view from the ridge is something.
There is a cave near {zone} that nobody seems to camp.
Already mapped out my spec to 50, starting to plan the suit.
The push from 40 to 50 is a real grind.
Starting to feel like 50 is actually reachable.
Anyone else pick up a few last levels in the frontier?
Almost 50 and my gear is still a mess.
How does everyone fill the time at 50 besides the frontier?
Went to {zone} just to look around, ended up staying for the experience.
Mapping out which realm abilities to buy first at 50.
Two levels to go, nobody talk to me until I ding.
Once I hit 50 it is straight to the frontier, no stops.
Ugh, this level is dragging.
Some levels fly by and some just sit there staring at you.
Slow and steady, that is how levels get done.
I never know whether to spend my spec points now or save them for later.
The level you dread is never the one that actually drags.
I keep telling myself one more bubble and then I stop. It never works.
Spec points burning a hole in my pocket.
Planned my whole spec on a scrap of paper and already changed it twice.
Leveled faster once I stopped trying to be clever about it.
The best experience is always wherever you are not.
Trained a new style and now I want to use it on everything.
Leveling is kind of relaxing once you stop watching the bar.
Nothing beats that first fight after training new spells.
The trick to leveling is not looking at the experience bar. I look at it constantly.
Some nights the experience just flows and you do not question it.
I used to rush every level, now I kind of enjoy the slow ones.
Pretty sure someone adds bubbles to my bar when I am not looking.
My experience bar and I are not on speaking terms.
My experience bar moves like it is stuck in mud.
How is everyone's leveling going?
What do you all think, spec deep early or spread out a bit?
The mid teens is where everything suddenly starts wanting to kill you.
The thirties are long, but at least you finally feel strong.
Around thirty I stopped counting how long each level takes.
So close to 50 I can almost touch it, and yet.
Every level past 45 feels like two of the old ones.
Being 50 is great until you realise the experience bar was half the fun.
I kind of miss having a reason to watch the experience bar.
Finally got a drop worth selling, my luck is turning.
Three hours of rings I cannot use and then a nice weapon. That is how it goes.
Some nights mobs carry nothing but rusty junk.
Every time I give up on a camp, the next fellow gets the drop.
Heh, another shiny cloak for the wrong class.
The named dropped two copper. Thanks for nothing.
People say luck is not real but they have never watched me loot.
I do not even read drops any more, I just sell whatever has the biggest number.
The best drop of my life was off a mob I almost skipped.
Found a weapon way too high for me, so it sits in the bank looking pretty.
Loot is like weather, you complain about it and nothing changes.
The mob always drops the good stuff right after you buy the same thing from a merchant.
I carry a lucky ring in my bags. It does nothing. I keep it anyway.
When the drop finally comes it never looks as good as you imagined.
Pretty sure the loot gods hate me.
If I had a gold for every useless cloak I looted, I could buy a useful one.
Looted something that made my night, not saying what.
My luck has been silly lately, two good drops in a row.
What is the best thing you ever looted?
Ugh, another pair of boots I cannot wear.
No drops for ages, the mobs are broke.
Always pray at your grave, every bit of experience counts.
The walk back after dying is where I think about my choices.
My bind point is always in the wrong place when I die.
I bind close to my camp now, learned that one the hard way.
Nothing humbles you like dying to something blue.
One tip for new folks: bind before you go anywhere new.
Every death teaches you something, mostly to look behind you.
I have a gravestone in every zone at this point.
The bind stone sees me more than my friends do.
If armor got heavier every time I died I could not move.
Paid the healer for my con again, my wallet weeps.
Con loss is the worst part, the walk back is just sad.
What is the dumbest way you ever died?
Well, that could have gone better.
And down I go. Walking back.
Just found out what the floor tastes like.
Dead again. At least the view from down here is nice.
Note to self: read the con before you swing.
Releasing. If anyone finds my dignity, it is on the ground back there.
That hit way harder than it looked.
I really thought I had that one.
Back to the bind stone, round two soon.
I have died so much the gravestones are forming a little village.
Soloing has one downside, nobody to rez you.
Dying down here means a long walk back in.
The runners are the worst, they always come back with friends.
Nothing pulls cleanly when you need it to.
There is always one mob that paths right through camp at the worst time.
Casters first, always. Learned that one the hard way.
The con color says blue, the mob says otherwise.
Funny how the small ones are always the meanest.
Mobs that evade everything should be against the law.
A purple con walking past camp makes everyone go very quiet.
If a mob looks friendly, it is lying.
Pet classes make every pull look easy, it is not fair.
I once saw a mob chase someone halfway across a whole zone.
The respawn timer always knows when you need a break, and ignores you.
Every camp has that one mob that hits like a cart full of rocks.
Animals are easy. It is the ones with swords and spells you watch out for.
Nothing scarier than a caster mob that roots you and keeps nuking.
I always check for adds before I pull now.
Mobs never seem to have the gold they should for all that armor they wear.
Mobs that link are why I check twice before every pull.
Undead never flee, which is the one nice thing about them.
Some mobs fight like they have a grudge against your whole family.
The mobs do not respawn, they just come back angrier.
Anyone else think undead hit harder than they should?
Leveled! Does that sound ever get old?
Pull, kill, sit. Pull, kill, sit. I love this camp.
The respawn here is just right, barely time to sit.
I have been at this camp so long the mobs know my name.
Good camp, good experience, no drama.
Camp is steady, no complaints.
This spot has a nice rhythm once you settle in.
Nobody else around, the camp is mine.
I moved a few steps over and the pulls got so much easier.
Every camp gets boring eventually, this one is close.
It is so dark down here, I keep jumping at shadows.
The air down here feels heavy, if that makes sense.
Every corner in here has something waiting.
I lost track of how long I have been down here.
Dungeon experience is great, dungeon walks back are not.
The echoes down here make every fight sound huge.
Careful pulls in here, things link like crazy.
I never trust corners in here.
I miss the sun already.
{zone} is busier than I expected.
Soloing is peaceful, nobody to blame but me.
Solo for now, slow but relaxing.
Solo experience is slow, but at least I do not share the loot.
Just me and my thoughts, nice for a change.
I kind of like the quiet now and then.
Anyone else talk to themselves when they solo?
Bags are full, time to sell.
Full bags and a long walk to the merchant, story of my life.
Had to leave a drop on the ground because my bags are full, painful.
I carry too much junk, I know, I know.
My pack weighs more than I do.
Dinged! Another one, feels good.
{level}, at last, off to the trainer.
New level, new spec points, no idea where to put them.
Leveled, and the next one already looks far.
{level} now, feeling stronger already.
Dinged solo, the hard way.
Nothing like a full bubble off one kill.
A good hour can be worth half a level.
I always say I will stop at the next ding, and then I do not.
The moment a rare drop hits the ground is pure magic.
I still check every drop twice, just in case.
I have had enough practice walking back from the bind that I know every rock.
Always check the con twice before you pull. Ask me how I know.
Some mobs just seem to know when you are low on health.
Wandering mobs have ruined more pulls than bad luck ever did.
The deeper I go down here, the nastier it gets.
One more drop and something has to go.
Grats me, I finally dinged.
Spawn is slow tonight.
Three up by the trees, careful.
Respawn here is quick, watch your back.
Anyone know the respawn timer here?
Nothing up, waiting on the spawn.
They spawn two at a time over there.
Spawn just reset, it is all clear for a moment.
Waiting on the {target} to pop, it always comes back here.
The {target} by the rocks is a caster, careful.
The big {target} near the fire hits like a truck.
Anyone know if the {target} drops anything good?
The orange ones here are worth the risk.
Careful pulling here, they link.
Pull from the edge or you get the whole group.
Somebody keeps pulling my spawn.
Pull them back to the hill, it is safer.
If you pull the left one the right one comes too.
Just me here, pulling slow.
Solo here, mind if I take the odd stray?
Two at a time is fine here if you are careful.
Hey, who else is here?
If you need a hand, just shout.
Watch the ledge here, easy to fall.
Anyone mind if I sit here and med?
Quiet here, nice change.
Someone sitting on the good spot again.
Good camp, decent view of {zone}.
Best camp in {zone} if you ask me.
Dark in here, keep close to the wall.
Nice to have neighbors, gets lonely out here.
This place is a maze, every corridor looks the same.
{zone} always makes me lose my sense of direction.
Who has a map of this place?
I swear we passed that torch already.
The adds in here come from nowhere.
Corridors are tight, one bad pull and it is over.
The respawn in {zone} is faster than outside, I swear.
Nice and quiet down here, too quiet.
Which way is out again?
Anyone know where the named spawns in {zone}?
If we wipe down here it is a long walk back.
That room past the stairs is a death trap.
I like dungeons, no weather and no zerg.
The echo in here makes everything sound closer.
I want to see the bottom floor of {zone} at least once.
Been down here so long I forgot what the sun looks like.
The deeper rooms have better experience, just saying.
Tomb of Mithra still gives me the creeps.
The haunting gloom in Mithra looks harmless until it hits.
Tepok's Mine is a lot of tunnels for a little experience.
Keltoi Fogou is cramped but the camps are good.
Stonehenge Barrows, where good groups go to get humbled.
The goblins in the barrows never stop coming.
Nisse's Lair Tomte are tougher than they look.
Cursed Tomb draugr warriors, still hate them.
Corpse crawlers in the Cursed Tomb, worst name worst monster.
The goblins in Vendo run for help every single time.
Varulvhamn werewolves hit like a falling tree.
Spindelhalla spiders give me the shivers.
Spindel has the best group camps in Midgard, no contest.
Muire Tomb mummy hags, nobody warned me.
Spraggon Den rock sprites, cute until they hit.
Koalinth Caverns are wet, cold and full of fish people.
Treibh Caillte is a long walk for a short pull.
Coruscating Mine is pretty, right up until something swings at you.
The crystal glow in Coruscating Mine makes it hard to see adds.
Darkness Falls demons do not care how good your gear is.
Darkness Falls seals add up fast if you keep pulling.
The necyomancers in Darkness Falls are always casting at someone.
My first dungeon ever, this place is creepy.
How do people find their way around down here?
Died again, how do people not die all the time?
Just leveled, do I need to see my trainer now?
Sitting for power, chat with me.
Waiting on a respawn, the most dangerous time to think.
Med break, anyone want to talk?
My health bar is filling slower than the respawn.
Camp bonus is nice here.
Experience is great tonight.
Half a bubble per kill, love it.
Stick on me, moving to the next room.
Regroup at the entrance.
Let us try the room past the corner, I think we can do it.
Keep the pulls coming, experience is great.
Pull faster, the respawn is waiting for us.
Anyone know what is past this room?
Grats grats.
Grats, long road.
Thanks for the rez.
Thank you, saved me the run.
Thank you, that bind run is brutal.
Thanks, back to it.
Releasing, see you at bind.
Too far for a rez, releasing.
Running back from bind.
Long run back to {zone}.
Anyone want to group while I run back?
Sick again, taking a break.
Rez sickness, give me a few.
Sitting out the sickness, then back.
Ding!
Ding, finally.
Ding {level}, off to the trainer.
{level}! Slow but steady.
Ding! Only took all night.
Ding {level}, time for new spells.
Ding! Thanks everyone who grouped with me tonight.
Ding {level}, on schedule.
Ding {level}. Next.
Well that went badly.
That {target} was not blue.
Back to my bind, see you in a bit.
Anyone near {zone} who can rez?
That was entirely my fault.
Worth it.
There goes my experience, ugh.
Anyone else camping here? Happy to share.
Mind if I hunt nearby? Will not take your pulls.
This spot is taken, I think, will move on.
Room for one more here if anyone needs it.
Pulling the whole room, stand back.
Bags are full again, heading to town.
How do my bags fill up this fast?
Off to the merchant, back in a bit.
Selling junk, then right back to it.
Full bags of materials, best kind of full.
Grats raid, what dropped?
Nice, first try?
Who got the loot?
Jealous, I never get raid spots.
Woo! Grats grats.
Good, that one used to wipe us every week.
Grats, what dropped?
Nice kill.
Big one, grats.
Who looted?
About time we got that one.
Nice, what dropped?
Grats all, well done.
Quick kill, nice.
That boss is mean.
What happened?
Who pulled?
Rough, good luck next try.
Long walk back from there.
Every time.
Try again, I am sure it was close.
Need more healers for that one.
That is a long run back.
Maybe next time.
Good luck next pull.
Ugh, wipes.
That boss hits hard.
Who died first.
Rez and go again?
Happens to everyone.
Bring more heals next time.
My backpack is full already, what do I keep?
